newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-YEBOAH ON THE WAY BACK FOR LEEDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YEBOAH ON THE WAY BACK FOR LEEDS.

text.p: Ghanaian international Tony Yeboah, sidelined for seven months by damaged knee ligaments, has been given the all-clear to resume light training with English premier league side Leeds next week.

Leeds manager George Graham said on Thursday: "It's good news and it's a bit earlier than we expected. Tony has been doing a lot of straightforward running but we'll just have to see how he progresses when he starts twisting and turning."
Yeboah's last appearance for Leeds was in the League Cup final defeat by Aston Villa in March.
